title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Projapati 2
desc: Generations of a Bengali family reunite for a festival, reshaping their bonds.
